draft_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) suggest that salience pre-filtering may help reduce unsupported entities in summaries.
revised_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) report that salience pre-filtering reduced the share of summaries containing an unsupported entity by 31% relative to the unfiltered summarizer across three news summarization benchmarks.
rationale: P1 states a concrete 31% reduction across three benchmarks, not a mere suggestion. The sentence's hedged "may help reduce" understates the reported result, so a stronger, scoped claim is supported.
